services.desc: Here is a picture of our RE/MAX Hot Air Balloon doing a "Splash and Dash" for an article featuring us in "Midwest Living" Magazine for March/April 2005. This picture was shot from our ride balloon. Dan has been the RE/MAX pilot since 1999. Dan is proud to be associated with the number #1 Realty Company and be one of the 70 Corporate RE/MAX Pilots around the World. The RE/MAX Balloon and Dan have appeared at the Iowa State Fair, RAGBRAI, Invention of Flight in Dayton Ohio, Ottumwa Pro Balloon Race and Waukee Fun Days, and many other events to numerous to mention.
